tldr: Google paused its open-source bug bounty program after a surge in AI-generated submissions overwhelmed it.
The U.S. has announced a new federal AI task force, adding another government body to follow as AI policy develops.

top.title: Google pauses open-source bug bounty program amid AI submissions
top.summary: Google has frozen its open-source bug bounty program, citing a significant rise in AI-generated submissions that is overwhelming the program.
top.why: Expect more noise in vulnerability-report channels; keep human verification and triage capacity in your security process.

also.title: Trump announces a federal AI task force called the Super Intelligence Force
also.summary: President Trump named Director of National Intelligence Jay Clayton to lead a new federal AI task force.
